cases.name: text job: a good weekly note passes

args.text:
This week you answered 5 of 6 days and did 3, which is real effort in a tired stretch. Mornings held better than evenings, and you said "evenings are dead for me", which fits what the check-ins show.

This may mean the plan sits at the wrong hour rather than that you lack will. A small test for next week: if the evening slot arrives and you are tired, move that item to the next morning instead of skipping it.
inputs: Week 5 to 11 Oct. Scheduled 6, answered 5, done 3. Answer rate 83%. Reasons: tired on 3 of 3 days marked Not or Part.
